newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: NBS says in talks, cautions shareholders.
newsitem.headline: NBS says in talks, cautions shareholders.

text.p: South African bank NBS Holdings Ltd (NBSH) said on Tuesday that it is in talks that could have an effect on its share price.
"Accordingly NBSH shareholders are advised to exercise caution in their share dealings pending the publication of a further announcement," the firm said.

On October 3 international rating agency IBCA reaffirmed the domestic short-term A1 and long-term A ratings of NBSH. The bank is South Africa's fifth largest by mnarket share and focuses on home loans.
The agency said that, given the resources of its major shareholders, more capital could be made available for the group if it needed them.
